blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office has turned over P17.8 million worth of medical equipment and two patient transport vehicles to the provincial government of Oriental Mindoro. The donation includes one portable digital X-ray machine, eight electrocardiogram (ECG) units, and five mechanical ventilators for the Oriental Mindoro Provincial Hospital (OMPH), alongside two new vehicles dedicated to patient transport. In a message on Tuesday, Provincial Health Officer Dr. Cielo Ante said the new equipment and vehicles will further strengthen the services available at the province’s five government hospitals, all of which have maintained a zero-balance billing policy since […]...
